## JSON-LD Structured Data & Compact Machine Feeds
Generated directly from normalized L1 records (`for_validation/*.json`) with deterministic `sourceRecordId`, `sourceHash`, ISO-8601 dates, retirement metadata, evidence classification (`evidenceLevel`, `verificationUrlKind`), and assertion verification timestamps (`lastVerifiedAt`):

- **Schema.org Linked Data (`credentials.jsonld`)**: Full `ProfilePage` / `EducationalOccupationalCredential` graph for Semantic Web and JSON-LD consumers. File: [credentials.jsonld](./credentials.jsonld) (`13528.01 KB`) | Raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VojislavMiloradovic/my-credentials/main/credentials.jsonld
- **Compact JSON Machine Feed (`credentials.feed.json`)**: Minified, token-optimized single-file JSON containing `countsByPlatform` and lean credential records (no repeated `@context`/`@type` boilerplate) for AI agents and fast full-portfolio loading. File: [credentials.feed.json](./credentials.feed.json) (`8611.25 KB`) | Raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VojislavMiloradovic/my-credentials/main/credentials.feed.json
- **Streaming NDJSON Machine Feed (`credentials.ndjson`)**: Newline-delimited JSON with one compact credential record per line, ideal for streaming parsers, `jq`, RAG chunking, and incremental ingestion. File: [credentials.ndjson](./credentials.ndjson) (`8610.90 KB`) | Raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VojislavMiloradovic/my-credentials/main/credentials.ndjson
